subtitles.speaker: Retainer
subtitles.en: Miyao Castle's water has already been cut off, and its garrison is suffering from thirst.

subtitles.speaker: Retainer
subtitles.en: The castle is badly damaged as well. It can hold five more days at most.

subtitles.speaker: Retainer
subtitles.en: Its fall is only a matter of time.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri son
subtitles.en: Father, we can no longer wait for the Murakami Navy to arrive.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri son
subtitles.en: If Miyao Castle falls, this war is as good as lost.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri son
subtitles.en: Above all, we cannot leave the men at Miyao to die.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri son
subtitles.en: We are short of ships, but that can't be helped now.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: There will be no retreat in this battle! The time has come!
